title: The Margin Erosion Mystery
subtitle: Where did 2.5 percentage points of gross margin go?
learning_objectives: Use AI to decompose an executive question into testable research hypotheses
Audit and triage sources for recency, scope coverage, and author bias before analyzing
Profile raw spreadsheets for anomalies before running mix-shift and cost analytics
Synthesize evidence into an actionable margin bridge rather than restated facts
deliverable: One-page margin bridge for the CFO
